title: stachys thunbergii
intro: Stachys thunbergii, commonly known as Sichuan hedgehog, is a perennial plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) that is native to China. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sichuan hedgehog include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and act as a digestive aid. The bioactive constituents of Stachys thunbergii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
